name: Nuke Site
desc:
In Nuke Site you try to survive nuclear explosions from over 30+ bombs from history. Destroy over 6+ different maps, earn atoms, buy special gears and try not to meet the same fate as your companions!

Available in these languages: Danish, English, French, German, Portuguese, Slovenian, Spanish, Turkish, and Vietnamese

Map Building Example: https://www.roblox.com/library/4338121670/Nuke-Site-Map-Example
